source.title: Whimsical Horrors
source.description:
As much as I enjoy the thought of you being the test subject for all of my inventions, this one has me a little uncertain. It is supposed to simply warp you a few yards forward, but when I poked the first prototype with a stick, it disappeared completely and took the stick with it!

I've made several adjustments since then, across multiple devices. I saw you mingling with the locals earlier, see if you can get them to try it out. Then maybe, if you're feeling brave, try it yourself.
source.progress: How goes the testing? As much as I don't care for these scarlet types, I would hate to discover that my device is causing agonizing deaths unrelated to combustion.
source.completion:
I'm... sorry?! Could you repeat that?

<Fizzlefuse's eyes glaze over, not with horror, but simply boredom.>

So you're saying the device works, it just seems to be getting some interference? Why didn't I think of that the first time. It makes total sense. I have no idea how to fix it, but it makes sense.

Here's the schematic, feel free tinker with it. I'm sure it's on the cusp of being the greatest short-range transportation device ever made.
